label: gym_mushi_040_kari_message_01
text: [EMPTY 27]

label: gym_mushi_040_receptionist_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Welcome to the Cortondo Gym,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].

label: gym_mushi_040_receptionist_01
text: Are you ready to challenge Gym Leader Katy,\nthe Sugarbug?

label: gym_mushi_040_receptionist_02
text: Very well. Allow me to show you to the\nbattle court.

label: gym_mushi_040_receptionist_03
text: Of course. Please feel free to come speak to me\nwhenever you’re ready.

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_entry_01
text: Eat up, my cute little Vivillon![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_mushi_040_poke_entry_01
text: Villooon!

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_01
text: Oh? What a lovely Trainer you are.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_02
text: Thank you very much for your skillful olive rolling.\nIt was quite impressive.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_03
text: Oh? Did I forget to introduce myself?\nForgive me.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_04
text: My name is Katy, and I am the owner here at\nPatisserie Soapberry.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_05
text: Oh? That’s right, I’m not in my shop—I’m on duty\nas leader of the Cortondo Gym right now![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_06
text: Forgive me. Ahem. My name is Katy, and I am\nthe Gym Leader here in Cortondo.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_07
text: My main line of work is crafting sweets as a\npastry chef.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_08
text: Little sweets that bring happiness with just one\nbite, Bug-type Pokémon hiding in foliage...\r\nBoth are small and yet very powerful.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_09
text: Don’t let your guard down unless you would like\nto find yourself knocked off your feet![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_10
text: Your strength rose during our battle like a nice\nbread in the oven.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_11
text: I feel that I may need to work on my own\nstrength as well![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_12
text: Congratulations! You passed! As proof of your\nvictory against me—the Gym Leader—allow me\r\nto present you with this Gym Badge.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_16
text: I hope you’ll enjoy it alongside a heaping serving\nof some of my deluxe handmade treats![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_badge
text: With [VAR 0x0200(0001)] Gym Badge[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s in your possession, Pokémon\nof up to Lv. [VAR 0x0201(0002)] will be easier to catch and will\r\nlisten to your commands as well.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_badge_all
text: With 8 Gym Badges in your possession, you will\nbe able to catch Pokémon of any level. They will\r\nall certainly listen to your commands as well.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_waza
text: I see you have quite the appetite as well! How\nabout a little TM as the frosting on this cake?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_13
text: Once you’ve found a TM during your travels,\nyou can then use a TM Machine to make copies\r\nof that TM. You did know that, right?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_14
text: I wish you luck in your future adventures. May\nthey be as sweet and lovely as a good dessert.[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_mushi_15
text: Off you go, then. Until we meet again![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

label: gym_mushi_040_receptionist_04
text: Congratulations! You’re now certified by the\nCortondo Gym!
